answer.justification: Only activation-level data were available. The layer profile rises early and then flattens: 0.088 at layer 1, 0.179 at layer 8, 0.189 at layer 16, 0.203 at layer 24 and 0.252 at layer 32. This matches the quantized ranges (0.185-0.196, 0.194-0.202, 0.202-0.209, 0.247-0.255). Final cosine 0.966 and mid-layer size ratio 0.969 (a shrink) also match quantized. Effective rank 4.17 (noise-like) and direction consistency 0.516 fit quantized, whereas fine-tuned is lower in rank and higher in consistency. Layer-2 spike 0.8 is small, which rules out system-prompted (31.7-64). The size ratio below 1 rules out fine-tuned (1.017-1.023). Layer-1 L2 of 0.088 is slightly below the quantized range but within single-draw variation. Nonzero values rule out base.
